reviews.text: Rotten first impression. My little guy deserves way better than this place.👎🏽
Fantastic practice. The doctors are highly skilled and knowledgeable, patient, and kind. Excellent, professional staff. My anxious dog loves them all. Clean facility. Highly recommend.
Amazing vet! They always make sure my dog is comfortable and well taken care of.
I usually use a low cost clinic because of cost, but Art Museum Vet certainly has  my vote.   Couldnt have had a better experience

My 3 cats have been going here for years. We see Dr Hommel. She is so thorough and helps us feel very informed about their health. She answers all the questions and guides us toward making the best decisions. The front desk staff is very helpful and quick to respond to queries on the phone. Fabulous vet and experience here!! Thank you AMV for all you do for our family! <3
Wonderful place! Friendly and knowledgable staff and doctors! Highly recommend!

Took both my dog and cat here for about a year and nothing but good things to say about them. Always provide top notch care, take time to explain things in simple terms and allow the handlers to be part of the planning/decision making process for health treatments. They always offer follow up calls to check on sick pets and have always been so responsive with any concerns we voice. Transparent about pricing. Our pup has vet anxiety and requires a muzzle and they are always so good with her and allow me to advocate for her so that she doesn’t get too stressed out at visits. We had to take kitty here for end of life treatment and they were nothing but kind and caring during that difficult time.

Mortimer may look like a grumpy boy all the time, but he LOVES the staff at AMVC. He purrs, lets them all do their thing, and always receives the best care. Dr. Pirok in particular is incredible. All the doctors are. She helped us diagnose our boy with IBD in a manner that didn’t overwhelm us with bills. She called us after hours with her own thoughts and recommendations, emails us promptly, and always follows through with any concerns we may have. The entire front of house staff is amazing with getting medications refilled promptly, allowing us to fit an appointment in when needed, and gives us check up calls the day after a visit. We know Morty is deeply cared for here and we will continue to trust the team with his health and well being.

Visit 3/19/26
As ever the best service and care I could ask for- for my two cats. Great listeners, an immaculate facility, exceptionally caring staff- what can I say? The best. I trust Dr. Hommel completely- today we met Jess at the front desk who called yesterday with pre-visit instructions and Grace- a new nurse to us and fantastic. Kennedy as always at reception. I thank you all.

Continued hats off to this wonderful practice. Nurse Emily called 90 mins before our visit and asked detailed “intake “ questions. Dr Nicolle Hommel -knowledgeable , caring, and approaches treatments with common sense and facts.  Kennedy at the front desk always expedites our visit.
Incredibly well trained, knowledgeable, professional, timely, attentive, responsive staff providing competitively priced services  in a great facility.  Best vet ever!

Visit 8/12/2025
Dr Hommel and the team here have been our providers for 6+ years! Everything I’ve complimented them for in the past is still applicable. A simply fantastic practice for all the reasons you want and need. Very impressed with the stability/longevity of the staff. Dr Hommel of course is an anchor, but Kennedy, Liz, Amberly as nurses/techs/admins- still here and still the best! Our nurse today was Ally- a newer face for us, but a great fit for the team. All I can say is thank you!!!!!!

This is the most WONDERFUL vet for my very sweet and very timid rescue dog, Millie. Doctor Hommel is absolutely amazing- so kind, gentle, patient, and knowledgeable, and all of the vet techs and front staff are just so sweet and gentle with handling Millie. I have always gotten appointments the week I called and even magically gotten last-minute, same-day appointments for more urgent situations. The way they prioritize Millie's comfort is so wonderful and heartwarming to see. I am definitely an anxious pet parent and take her to the vet a lot/ask a lot of questions, but they never make me feel like I'm crazy for doing so hahaha. Millie also sees a specialist at Penn and they are amazing with communicating with the specialist regarding things like bloodwork and routine monitoring, etc. Veterinary care, like human healthcare, is expensive everywhere right now- especially in Philadelphia. I find the prices here be generally the same as what is offered by other clinics in the area.

I never write negative reviews, but I've had a few too many negative experiences here. Most recently, I brought my cat in for a sick visit. The vet examined her for all of one minute and determined my cat's pain was dental related and I'd need to get her another dental cleaning. Mind you, she'd had a dental cleaning/extraction 2 months before (at this vet's insistence!). They sent me home with pain killers that most cats get after surgery, and an estimate for a $3k dental cleaning.

Nothing about this visit felt right (including when they put me in a very weird position about which bloodwork to order - the standard one, or the one double the cost "that the vet recommends"). So I took my cat to a different vet practice and after a very thorough exam, they determined her pain was a muscle injury, not dental at all. Proceed with caution at Art Museum Vet.

Proceed with caution. I went here because my dog needed some imaging as determined by her primary care. I called around to different vets who would do this for the lowest price because she may need this care for the rest of her life and I need to make it economically feasible. I stated this clearly when making the appointment and was told they would still need to do a wellness appointment to establish care. That was fine to me, but then they used that appointment to try and get me to get a bunch of other services. At the end I was able to push back and leave with just the imaging. I emailed them to ask them to send the images to her PCP and turns out they did an ultrasound and didn’t take any pictures. So I was out if $150 and now have to go through this process again (obviously with another vet). Please be firm with these guys because they will try and upsell you like your pet is a car and you’re trying to get an oil change without 20 more things the shop is trying to sell you.

We've been going to Art Museum Vet since we got our pup almost 8 years ago, and they've been with us through vet anxiety, a torn ACL, intentional weight loss, and going from a little puppy to a senior dog. Cannot recommend them enough.

This is the best vet my dog has been in 13 years. Today was her (Reeses) 1st visit and from the front desk, the techs and the Vet (Dr. Hope) the experience was truly amazing. The office is very clean, the staff is super friendly, they answered all my questions and explained in details. They showed compassion and you can they all love animals. I would highly recommend this practice to anyone who want the best care for their pets.

Update: As of 11/23 Reese passed away and she was 16 1/2 years old. I was fortunate enough to take the photos in the red glamour dress an hour before she passed away peacefully and naturally at home. I just want to clearly thank Art Museum Vet for always being compassionate, kind, and always treating Reese like family. There were many times this year Reese was sick and art museum vet always made miracles happen. My financial situation was not the best and they always treated her, provided care and medication with solutions and worked with what I can provide since she was an established patient. Once again if you want the best care for your fur babies please go to Art Museum Vet. They treat you and the babies like Family.
Incredible staff and excellent veterinarians.

I can only speak for Dr Hommel but I am sure all the other docs are similar - she is a gem. She cares so much for the animals. And she manages client (pet owner) sadness and anxiety admirably. I’m incredibly grateful. She’s looked after 6-7 animals of mine over the years, some to their final days. The staff are also so kind about fielding medical questions and requests over emails and phone call and relaying to Dr Hommel to get timely responses - I feel like everyone is taking care of my animals even outside of the appointment.
Great service! They are very communicative both in and outside of appointments for follow up questions/concerns.
Wonderful place with very caring doctors and staff. Special shout out to Dr. Hommel and Saylor. Highly recommend!
Very nice and helpful
Fabulous vets and techs and efficient and cordial staff. Appreciate open and informative discussion of care plans. They have been great for two family dogs.
Excellent vet practice!  Everyone is so caring and professional!

Really appreciated my recent experience taking our dog Luna in for a torn nail which she wouldn’t let us touch. They handled it within moments of calling them at a reasonable cost. Great care, peace of mind and service. Thank you!

Absolutely everyone has been super attentive and caring from the front door and every interaction after. My dog recently had an emergency event and they were so compassionate with her and us as we navigated the uncertainty and stress of the situation. Following the event and her surgery at another emergency vet they've communicated with her specialists,  had very thorough conversations with me to ensure they haven't missed anything and that I understand all thats going on and checked up on her regularly. So appreciated.

I started taking my cat here recently and they've been lovely. He was a street cat and they were very thorough in their initial work-up along with giving me advice as a new cat owner on what he needs. Picture of the lil guy for cuteness.

Service and quality of care is fantastic and we will be bringing our pet here again. However, the neutering cost estimate was 10x what we got at the SPCA. I don’t think you can neuter a dog ten times as well. So be a smart consumer and shop around for your procedures.

Amazing vet! My dog was a new patient and we were able to get an appointment within one week. Everyone I talked to was courteous, helpful, kind, and efficient. They were very gentle and good with my dog, and also clear communicators with me. They also called my dog's previous vets and had his records all ready! Best vet I've ever been to.

I made an appointment with Art Museum to organize paperwork with a USDA vet for international travel with my pet. I arrived for the appointment, and the appointment had been cancelled due to miscommunication with their sister clinic. They then told me they could see me to establish care and start the conversation for organizing international paperwork. Then I met with the vet who told me they couldn't support me in organizing the scope of needs for paperwork, but could complete the paperwork if they were provided what was needed and recommended I work with a travel consultant. I spoke with the travel consultant who was recommended, and called the clinic back to organize the health certificate. The front desk rep was incredibly rude and told me that she needed a list of items to organize via the travel consultant. When I told her I was actively providing that list to her, she told me maybe I should work with another USDA vet and the vet would only coordinate directly with a travel consultant moving forward. I told her that should have been disclosed before I paid a $100+  "establishing care" that otherwise would not have been "established" had I been informed of that policy upfront. She refused to reimburse me for the services I never would have proceeded with had I been properly informed of their... policy. I was also prescribed several medications for my dog that were not correctly explained and cost significantly more than what was disclosed, which was fun to discover at check out. Would not recommend.

I’ve taken both my cat and dog here for years! I’ve never had a vet that my pets feel so safe with. It’s so nice that I get to be in the room during exams and vaccines. They really do amazing work. They have always been so communicative, especially since we don’t have insurance it’s so incredibly helpful that they go through pricing line by line. I could not recommend this vet more!!!
The whole team here is so lovely (and they always make sure you have an estimate for everything ahead of time— sometimes rare for city vets!) …
Courteous and caring. Highly recommend.
Wonderful wonderful wonderful!!! We took our meow for an annual exam and the staff there were super nice and helpful. Definitely our to-go vet
This is a great vet service in Philadelphia. If your pet needs care, please take the time to bring them here and avoid places such as Arts City. You and your pet will not be disappointed.
Best vet experience I've ever had. It's officially our pet's new vet.
Excellent business with excellent customer service

Always a good experience with the staff here at Art Museum Veterinary Center.  They are friendly, knowledgeable, and very transparent.  I would recommend all of my Philly friends send their pets here.
Friendly and knowledgeable, they do an excellent job. We'll definitely be coming here as long as we remain in Philly.
